description.narrative: ECCDA has worked in Luang Prabang province for over 15 years. This is an FSTP project document for Group 1 (CSOs): Supporting organizations to influence the private sector and private sector representatives through awareness-raising campaigns. The project will review various documents, policies, regulations, and programs, and analyze them to provide data and a foundation for project implementation. It will conduct a feasibility study on encouraging the private sector and private sector representatives tosupport farmers inproduction and marketing. At least 6 private sector entities and 15 private sector representatives will be selected to participate in the project. They will support improving the productivity and quality of farmers' production through the application of CSA methods, developing market value chains, investment, competitiveness, enhancing knowledge and capacity, and promoting gender equality among farmers, the private sector, and private sector representatives – specifically encouraging the participation of women and youth. The project will identify gaps and obstacles hindering the encouragement of private sector support for farmer groups in agriculturalproduction, marketing, processing, packaging, sales, etc. – issues that affect CSA implementation – and present them to relevant stakeholders for policy improvement. Goal: To see collaboration from more than 6 private sector entities and 15 private sector representatives to support farmers and communities in agricultural production and marketing using CSA methods, in order to improve productivity and product quality, as well as increase value and ensure sustainable competitiveness, across 6 villages in 3 target districts of Luang Prabang province. Objectives:To collect feasibility data and select 6 private sector entities, along with 15 private sectorrepresentatives and relevant stakeholders, to support farmers and communities in agricultural production and marketing, and to develop market value chains, in 6 villages across 3 target districts of the project. To encourage more than 6 private sector entities and 15 private sector representatives to collaborate with farmers and communities in production using CSA methods to improve productivity and product quality, as well as increase value and competitiveness, aligned with the prominent potential of each village, including establishing product purchase agreements and promoting product processing, across 6 villages in 3 target districts of the project.

participating-org.narrative: ECCDA establish on June 8, 2004, the association received support from the Friends in Development Foundation in Thailand, which hada cooperative project with the Lao Women's Union Central Committee called the Small-Scale Rural Development Project for Women. The project team that established the ECCDA association applied that project management system to administer the association's projects.They also received training from donors supporting the association's projects, such as: receiving funding supportfrom HomeNet SouthEast Asia (HNSEA) from 2005 to 2025. International NGOs helped establish savings groups, informal labor groups, and agricultural production groups in Vientiane Capital, Luang Prabang Province, and Houaphanh Province, totaling over 20 groups. They also helped establish the Home Net Lao (HNL) network, which is a member of the HNSEA network and a member of HomeNet International. Received fundingsupport from Oxfam in Laos from 2014-2021 to implement the project "Equity in Access to SocialProtection for Informal Workers." From January 2017 to June 2018, received funding support from FAO to implement the project supporting legal timber production. From January 2018 to February 2019, received funding from UNDP-GEF to implement the Forest and Biodiversity Conservation Project at the Xim Watershed, with a conservation area of approximately 5,383 hectares, benefiting 863 people across 5 villages in Viengxay District, Houaphanh Province. This project had many notable activities such as: watershedforest conservation activities, community income generation activities, and Kardung cardamom planting activities, which became model activities for Houaphanh Province. Summary of projectmanagement experience: The association has its own association regulations, office administration regulations, and internal financial regulations. When undertaking a project, it adheres to the donor's regulations in line with the donor's rules, following the donor's financial regulations. After successful fundraising,thedonor provides financial training and guidance on reporting project activity implementation according to the project proposal, as well as financial reporting according to the agreed terms with the donor. The main activities of the association are tocontinue promoting groups and small businesses through project activities for which the association seeks funding support from international NGO donors. Target areas have included Vientiane Capital, Luang Prabang Province, Houaphanh Province, and Khammouane Province. The association's groups have united to form the Home Net Lao network in Vientiane Capital, Luang Prabang Province, and Houaphanh Province, as well as a network of small and medium-sized wood processing companies in Khammouane Province comprising6 companies. This follows the association's strategic plan for 2022 to 2026. The main activities are promoting income generation for members of over 20 groups, savings mobilization and fund expansion, production of goods, agriculture,handicrafts, etc.,and promoting marketing and sales by developing the use of digital tools to enhance sales. Seeking donor assistance to continue supporting the association's member groups and networks. Vision: A green Lao PDR, communities that are prosperous andhappy, able to help each other, strong, and connected internationally. Mission: To establish and promote the development of groups,group networks, and communities to be strong, capable of socio-economic self-sufficiency and sustainability. - Promote social protection for members and informal workers, especially migrant workers and disadvantaged workers. - Promote and disseminate environmental conservation to communities, contributing to environmental conservation at national and international levels. - Compile lessons learned and outstanding experiences of the association to exchange, transfer, and cooperate with the government sector, networks, and relevant international organizations.
